text: {"lessons":["My account fell over these periods despite several rebounds; those moves do not tell me what prices will do next, so I should not chase a recovery or sell out of fear.","Doing nothing was consistent with my view that short-term changes are unpredictable; I should trade only when a holding or my portfolio no longer fits my plan.","When I next review my account, I should focus on diversification and future risk and return—not my purchase price, the pain of a loss, or the pleasure of realizing a gain."]}
